message: Profiles of the students were sent over by Teacher Sasaki.
Checking and looking at the four faces on a hologram, I walk toward the stadium.

name: Iori
message: 「Kazamine Setsugekka... Martial Arts Division Year 1. Kazamine Keisetsu, <d0008>Quartermaster Division</d> Year 1.」

name: Iori
message: 「And then Tobe Ririmu and Suzakuin Momiji... Both Martial Arts Division Year 1, huh.」
Murakumo Academy has three divisions: the Martial Arts Division, the <d0007>Technical Division</d>, and the Quartermaster Division.
The Martial Arts Division is for training swordsmen who wield the spiritual mechanical blade "Origami."
The Technical Division is mainly for training swordsmiths who forge Origami.
The Quartermaster Division trains those who support duties related to <d0088>Jindou</d>.

name: Iori
message: 「Three in the Martial Arts Division and one in the Quartermaster Division—the ones I'll be teaching are probably the three, right?」
Well, she did say we'd sort out the details later, so let's meet them in person first and see what kind of students they are.

name: Iori
message: 「...This is the place.」
The students' names were listed on the academy's facility reservation system.
Murakumo Academy Stadium—
This is where the academy students' summer festival, the <d0009>Murakumo Martial Festival</d>, is held.
The Martial Festival is a massive event that the academy's students pull together as one to put on.
Selected students from the Martial Arts Division test their skill against each other in matches to decide who is number one.
It is broadcast on TV nationwide and is famous enough to be called one of the "Two Great Summer Traditions" alongside Koshien baseball.

name: Iori
message: 「Never thought I'd come back here.」
I remember the time I spent here during my third summer as an academy student. Even though I thought I'd never come back again...
Funny how karma works.
Stepping inside, the familiar sound of blades clashing echoed out.

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, they're at it.」
On the stadium stage, two girls were glaring at each other with their blades pointed at one another.

name: Momiji
message: 「Quite the skill you have there, Tennouji Victoria-san.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ehehe, well yeah~！！」

name: Iori
message: 「That's... Suzakuin Momiji?」
With her white hair streaming, a petite girl was charging in boldly with strikes.
She's one of the girls from the profiles I got from Teacher Sasaki.
The <d0010>Suzakuin Family</d>—I know her background well, too. There probably isn't anyone in martial circles who doesn't know that name.
―After the war, GHQ ordered a ban on citizens wearing swords. However, many long―standing martial families opposed this.
The one who stood up to protect the sword, which could truly be called the soul of the samurai, was her ancestor, Suzakuin Ryouan.
He organized many martial families and founded the 『<d0011>Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association</d>』.
Prepared even for armed uprising, he demanded that GHQ lift the ban on wearing swords. Through their efforts, the samurai succeeded in protecting their soul, the sword.
Ever since, the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association has been passed down unbroken through the Suzakuin bloodline, boasting its power even today in the twenty-first century.
Incidentally, the current chairman of the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association is Suzakuin Masamori. He is her grandfather.
He founded this Murakumo Academy in order to raise skilled swordsmen.

name: Iori
message: 「……So that girl is the founder of the academy's granddaughter, huh.」
The Suzakuin are an elite family standing at the very top even among martial families.
Momiji, born into that family, is someone who could truly be called a princess.
To teach someone like her is a tremendous undertaking.

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, looks like it's going to get interesting.」
The corners of my mouth involuntarily loosen.
A mission that comes with hardship is also one that brings a stronger sense of worth.

name: Momiji
message: 「Your guard is wide open, Victoria-san！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa！？ That was close, that one almost hit me~！」
Victoria-san barely dodges Momiji's sharp strike.

name: Momiji
message: 「……Your movements seem rather sluggish. Are you holding back？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm—？ I don't mean to be, y'know.」
Facing her, Victoria-san runs a hand through her blonde hair sparkling in the sunlight and laughs carefree.
Just as Momiji said, she doesn't seem to be in top form.

name: Victoria
message: 「But y'know, I just can't really get hyped up~」
Tennouji Victoria—third year in the Martial Arts Division, champion of last year's Murakumo Martial Festival.
She holds the title of 『<d0012>Toujinegi</d>』, which signifies the pinnacle of Murakumo Academy.
In short, Victoria-san is currently the strongest in the academy.

name: Momiji
message: 「As for me, since it's a precious opportunity, I'd like to do my best so that it becomes meaningful time for both of us.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Because it's a rare chance with me, the Toujinegi, fighting Suzakuin-chan, right？」

name: Victoria
message: "Everyone definitely wanted to see this match, you know~"

name: Victoria
message: "So wh~y?! Why is it a closed match with no audience?!"

name: Momiji
message: "I already told you, this is a practice match. It is not something to put on display for outsiders."

name: Victoria
message: "Eeehh! No way, no wa~y, I want people watching us~!"

name: Victoria
message: "We rented out the whole arena for a match, and I can't get fired up when the stands are this empty~!"

name: Victoria
message: "<d0013>Fan service is important!</d> Suzakuin-chan, you need to give the fans some service too!"

name: Momiji
message: "I have no need for fans or anything of the sort."

name: Victoria
message: "Huuuh?! What's the point of fighting if there aren't any fans watching?!"
Apparently Victoria-san wanted to hold a flashy practice match with a crowd, but Momiji turned the idea down.
At this academy, every student in the Martial Arts Division aims to become the Toujinegi.
So whenever the reigning Toujinegi holds a practice match, eager students flock to study it.
Of course, the fighters themselves decide whether spectators are allowed. This time, they chose to keep outsiders out.
"Honestly, Vicky, stop being so selfish..."
Another student was sitting in the front row of the spectator stands.
"Vicky, you were the one who agreed to the match even without an audience, weren't you?"
"Throwing a tantrum about it now is hardly fair."

name: Victoria
message: "I kno~w, bu~t...!"
So this girl is talking directly with Victoria-san down on the stage.

name: Muragaki Iori
message: "Are you Victoria-san's <d0014>Second</d>?"

name: Girl
message: 「Hieek……！？」
When I spoke to her, the girl flinched visibly and took a step back.

name: Muragaki Iori
message: "S-Sorry, did I startle you?"

name: Girl
message: "B-But I set the facility reservation to private... How did you get in here?"

name: Muragaki Iori
message: "Oh, I started working as a teacher at this academy today."
Normally, reserving a facility as private keeps unrelated people from entering.
Teachers are the exception, though—they can come and go freely even when a student sets a reservation to private.
When Sasaki-sensei sent me the student profiles earlier, she included my academy teacher ID as well.

name: Muragaki Iori
message: "I'm Muragaki Iori. I'll be taking charge of a first-year class."

name: Minamoto Shizuku
message: "I'm Minamoto Shizuku, a third-year in the Technical Division."

name: Iori
message: Huh? <d0015>Minamoto</d> as in that Minamoto clan?

name: Shizuku
message: Yes, that Minamoto... as embarrassing as it is to admit
The Minamoto family are descendants of Minamoto no Yoritomo, who established the Kamakura shogunate and became head of the warrior class.
Alongside the Suzakuin Family, there's probably no swordsman who doesn't know them.

name: Iori
message: I'm getting to meet all kinds of legends today, huh

name: Shizuku
message: P-Please stop... I'm really not anything that grand...
My eyes drifted to the tablet device hiding her mouth.

name: Iori
message: Hm？ You're using a pretty old-fashioned gadget.
Holographic displays are common now, so only a serious eccentric uses a physical display.

name: Shizuku
message: Ah, this is, well... sort of like a shield...

name: Iori
message: A shield？

name: Shizuku
message: Having a physical barrier between myself and other people makes me feel a little safer...
Ah, so that's it.
Seems Shizuku is quite shy.

name: Iori
message: Hold on. I feel like I've heard the name Minamoto Shizuku somewhere...

name: Iori
message: Right, I remember now. Shizuku, you were in last year's Martial Festival, weren't you?
That was certainly last year's Martial Festival.

name: Shizuku
message: Y-Yes... though it was just for data collection, not that I was being serious...

name: Iori
message: Huh, you mean you made it all the way to the Martial Festival finals without even being serious？ If anything, isn't that even more amazing...！？

name: Shizuku
message: Hauu, sorry
Shizuku shuffled backward with a frightened look.

name: Iori
message: Oops, did I scare you again？

name: Shizuku
message: No, it's not that... it's not that Sensei is at fault...！

name: Shizuku
message: I'm just bad at talking to people I don't know, and I don't really know how to act around them...

name: Iori
message: Got it. Sorry for not being more considerate.
I put a little space between us.

name: Shizuku
message: No, it's fine... thank you
Once I actually talked to her, she had no arrogance at all despite being a descendant of the Minamoto. She's such an adorable student.

name: Victoria
message: Huh, feels like there's somehow one more stranger here

name: Victoria
message: 「Shizu's acquaintance？　Maybe a lover？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「N-n-no, that's not it, he's my teacher」

name: Momiji
message: 「A teacher？ I don't recognize him, though……」
A suspicious gaze is directed at me from Momiji.

name: Iori
message: 「Is it alright if I watch the match, you two？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Sure, sure～！ Watch as much as you want～！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Suzakuin-chan's okay with it too, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Well, if he is a teacher」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yes! My hype's starting to go up a bit～」
Victoria swings her arms around with a whoosh-whoosh.

name: Victoria
message: 「Still, it's no fun without an audience, right～. A match has to be hot and excitin'！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Does that mean you're going to get serious for us？」
Smiling calmly, Momiji readies her Origami again.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm～, but it's just one more spectator～」

name: Momiji
message: 「What will it take for you to get serious？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh, I know. Then give me a reward if I win」

name: Momiji
message: 「Is there something you want?」

name: Victoria
message: 「Non-non, as long as you let me savor Suzakuin-chan's body, I'm good」

name: Momiji
message: 「S-savor, you say……！？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Fufufu, I like touching muscles～」

name: Victoria
message: 「Suzakuin-chan, I'm thinking your build is slender, yet toned and has a nice body」

name: Victoria
message: 「So y'know, if I win, let me touch Suzakuin-chan's body」

name: Momiji
message: 「N-no, no way, that's……!」

name: Victoria
message: 「N fufu, it's fine. Everyone'll be happy, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I-I'm sorry, but between women or stuff like that, I really can't……！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmph？ Both are OK with me, you know？」
O-oh…… is that right, it's moving along then

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky, give it a rest. That's sexual harassment.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Aww, but I want a reward……」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Hold back, please.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Then if I win, will Shiz let me touch you instead？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「A-again？ I let you touch it before, didn't I……」

name: Victoria
message: 「A reward, a reward～!」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Geez, there's no helping you……」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hyahha! Yes! That got me just a little motivated!」
Victoria starts doing a little hop on the stage.

name: Iori
message: 「Shizuku-san, is that okay……？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「With Vicky, it's because she 'wants to check how someone's muscles are built,' so originally it's not really anything lewd……」
I see, so she's trying to size up physical ability by actually touching them

name: Shizuku
message: 「Still, she comes in to touch pretty much without holding back, so…… um…… I guess it might be tough for people who aren't used to it……」
Being Victoria's Second looks pretty rough too.

name: Victoria
message: 「Okay！ Then Suzakuin-chan, let's resume！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I was growing weary of waiting. Whenever you're ready.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Okay, okay, then I'll try just a little bit～！」
Grinning, Victoria pulls her hips way back.

name: Victoria
message: 「Listen up and watch closely, you unruly, outrageous, reckless punks who cross Lord Shogun！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Now that thi-is Okita-kun has arrived, I won't let you have your way！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Our <d0067>Tennen Rishin-ryuu</d> is the number-one swordsmanship under heaven！！」

name: Iori
message: 「What is that」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Apparently it's the catchphrase from Vicky's favorite anime, '<d0016>Go-Go Okita-kun</d>'……」
Come to think of it, she blurted out something like that during last year's Martial Festival too……

name: Momiji
message: 「I see, so I am a patriot of <d0017>Sonnou Joui</d>. Well, that is not entirely mistaken.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Since I'm going to defeat Victoria-san, the <d0018>barbarian</d> who came all the way from America, right here and now.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Fufuuh, are you provoking me？ Are you agitating me？」

name: Momiji
message: 「You're welcome to take it that way.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Niiice, I really love stuff like that！ Good, good~！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Let's keep hyping up this matchmaking~」
In stark contrast to just a moment ago, Victoria-san's vigor swells.

name: Victoria
message: 「So then, today's rush forecast~！！」
Just as she held the Origami's blade level with the ground――

name: Victoria
message: 「Right now, I'm feeling like……」

name: Victoria
message: 「……Yeah！ Three katanas！！」
The instant she shouted――the Origami Victoria-san was holding split into three.

name: Iori
message: 「W-Whoa there, what is that……！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Here I come, Suzakuin-chan！！」
In a single step, Victoria-san invades Momiji's striking range.

name: Momiji
message: 「I won't let you……！！」
Responding, Momiji steps forward.

name: Victoria
message: 「――Yugen Mugen, Sonic Rush！！！」
Super-high-speed, multi-hit thrusting out of a dash――a three-stage thrust attacks Momiji.
As expected of a Suzakuin, one might say.
Even while wearing a pained expression, Momiji deflected every single thrust Victoria-san unleashed.
Yet from the final blow she met head-on, she is sent flying far backward.

name: Momiji
message: 「……So this is Victoria-san's thrust. It's my first time taking it firsthand, and despite how fast it is, it packs tremendous power.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa, you blocked all of that？ Amazing~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Naturally. Still, that wasn't your full power, was it？」

name: Momiji
message: 「At last year's Martial Festival, you should have shown even fiercer thrusts.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm, was it like that？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I told you, didn't I, that I want you to get serious. Why don't you stop holding back soon？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm, asking me to get hyped up to the same level as the Martial Festival right here is pretty unreasonable~」

name: Momiji
message: 「So you're saying facing someone like me doesn't get you hyped up？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Huff-huff, maybe so」

name: Momiji
message: 「Look how thoroughly I'm being looked down on……！！」
This time Momiji charges――developing into a fierce clash of blades.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Shizuku-san. That thing Victoria-san used just now…… the blade suddenly split into 3, right? How does that mechanism work?」

name: Shizuku
message: 「That's a visual effect Vicky asked me to build in……. It displays floating Origami using HR」

name: Shizuku
message: 「It's supposedly a special move from Go-Go Okita-kun」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, so it's a presentation gimmick that triggers based on mental resonance value」

name: Iori
message: 「Come to think of it, even in pro matches there are players who use Origami with that kind of presentation gimmick built in to hype up the crowd」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, it's the first time I've seen an academy student use one. It's elaborate and fun」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I-I'm so glad…… to have someone who understands」

name: Shizuku
message: 「That doesn't just display a holographic sword—it also puts out a light fog to set the atmosphere, you know」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Though effects like that have strict regulations」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Displays that block an opponent's vision are prohibited, and effects that camouflage attacks are NG too」

name: Shizuku
message: 「That effect is properly tuned to pro standards. It would make me sad too if people thought she cheated」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, so you're the one who made it. Pretty impressive」
Being able to prepare pro-spec Origami complete with effects makes her a blacksmith with a bright future.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Yes! I contacted the regulations rep at the Jindou Association and went back and forth so many times—it really was tough……！」
Saying that, she inches closer and closer to me.

name: Iori
message: 「Um, don't you think that's a little close……」

name: Shizuku
message: 「W-Whoa, s-s-sorry, sorry！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Whenever it comes to Origami, I end up getting carried away……」

name: Iori
message: 「Nah, don't worry about it. Having passion is a good thing」
Everything starts with curiosity and passion. Strong, boiling-hot feelings become the driving force that elevates yourself.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Even so……」
Shizuku-san shifts her gaze to the match between Victoria-san and Momiji.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky isn't showing her usual strength at all today. I guess she really can't get into gear unless it's the real thing...」
Even if she isn't fighting at her best, she's still trading blows evenly with Momiji.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji-san looks like she's holding back too, doesn't she」
Suzakuin Momiji has never once appeared in an official match. Because of that, her true ability is an unknown quantity.
Even so, just watching her is enough to tell that she isn't going all out.
Just what on earth is she thinking—

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey, hey, heeey, what's the matter, Suzakuin-chan? You're not landing a single hit~?」

name: Momiji
message: （Sigh... This really won't do）
Irritation builds inside me as Victoria-san keeps nonchalantly deflecting my blade.
In April―right after enrolling at Murakumo Academy, I challenged Tennouji Victoria―san to a practice match.
However, she's the reigning Toujinegi. Being quite the popular figure, her schedule was booked solid until May.
And then, the long-awaited Golden Week came to an end. At last, I finally got my chance to have a practice match with Victoria-san.
A practice match with her was the perfect opportunity to see the Toujinegi's true strength, and I was simply looking forward to fighting her.
And yet, this pathetic state of affairs.
Even though I went out of my way to prepare my <d0019>Spirit-Type Armament</d> for today, she won't get serious at all.
At this rate, it's just a one-woman show—a complete waste of effort.

name: Momiji
message: （I'm not practicing Jindou for fun...！）
My Origami—Tsubakuro Nagamitsu—let out a high-pitched shriek.
Its exceedingly long blade is reinforced by my Tenju, maintaining enough durability to withstand even a direct collision with a 4-ton truck.
Yet that very Origami trembled slightly upon taking a single blow from Victoria-san.

name: Momiji
message: 「As expected of the reigning Toujinegi—what a heavy strike...！」
Tennouji Victoria-san's true strength, something you only understand after taking a blow yourself. She's a pure power fighter.
Her heavy, power-packed attacks steadily sap her opponent's arm strength and stamina. Dragging this out in a sluggish exchange will only put me at a disadvantage.

name: Victoria
message: 「All right, here I come again~！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Listen up and watch closely, you unruly, outrageous, reckless punks who cross Lord Shogun！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Now that thi-is Okita-kun has arrived, I won't let you have your way！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Do you really have to announce that every single time！？」
Seeing no obligation to play along, I unleash a thrust without hesitation.

name: Victoria
message: 「Of course！ The intro spiel is important！」
Without even parrying or dodging my strike, she absorbed it completely using only the <d0086>Barrier Jacket</d> deployed around her.

name: Victoria
message: 「How's it feel right now~？」

name: Victoria
message: 「...Three katanas！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I won't let you get away！！」
As I fall back, Victoria-san closes in right on my heels.

name: Victoria
message: 「Ethereal Phantasm, Sonic Ruuuush！！！」
The thrust unleashed by Victoria-san shoots forward at terrifying speed.
Three times in a split second—from the receiving end, there's no way I could make it in time dealing with them one by one.
A wide sweep, neutralizing every thrust. My Origami lets out a high-pitched ring.

name: Momiji
message: （If I take this head-on, my Origami won't hold up...！）
A terrifying sonic thrust, despite being a power fighter. An ordinary Barrier Jacket could shatter from a single blow.
It was a thrusting technique that made it easy to see how Tennouji Victoria-san climbed all the way to Toujinegi.

name: Momiji
message: （Still, that's within expectations. I really wanted to learn her upper limit, though...）
It doesn't look like I can hope for that in this practice match.

name: Momiji
message: 「...I see.」

name: Momiji
message: 「In that case, that's enough.」
From our exchange so far, I've pretty much "figured her out."
Sword techniques used, telegraphing motions, spacing, tactical algorithms, offensive and defensive skills, frequent routines, combination patterns, and their combination probabilities.
Gaze, facial expressions, blinking, breathing methods, muscle reflexes, hand habits, weight shifting, blind-spot compensation, and every other physiological reaction.
Psychological tendencies, personality traits, interpersonal judgment, logical reasoning ability, thinking speed, stress tolerance, emotional restraint, and their strategic impact.
Roughly all the information that makes up the person known as Tennouji Victoria-san has been accumulated in my brain.
<center>Not enough, yet for now, entirely sufficient.</center>

name: Momiji
message: （...<d0020>Shingan no Kiwamete</d>, initiate）
Muttering softly, I switch the circuits in my head.
Move 1, approximately 14 predicted opening actions.
Move 2, 13 effective counters against predicted tactical action #1, 16 effective counters against #2, effective counters against #3—
Approximately 156 nodes in the Move 2 action tree; next, Move 3.
Move 8, Move 9, Move 10――
Instantly forming an action tree up to 20 moves ahead. Roughly 3.8e+21 terminal nodes.
Deriving the optimal solution from a vast number of predicted futures via an empirical evaluation function.

name: Momiji
message: 「――Route search complete」
I don't know if I can carry it all the way to checkmate, but it's just right for testing how effective it is against a Toujinegi.

name: Momiji
message: 「Here I come, Victoria-san」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah, GO GO～！！」
The precognitive Tennouji Victoria-san created by my brain takes shape.
A phantom image of mine, visible only to me, generated by high-sensitivity, high-definition foresight.
And so, reality begins to trace the shadow I've generated――
Move 1, a diagonal slash from the opponent's upper stance. Reality match rate 93.482 percent. 1 cm to the right of the prediction, data corrected――evaded.
Move 2, a gaze feint toward the right shoulder followed by a grazing slash at 320 m/s 6 cm below the right foot――hit.

name: Victoria
message: 「Nku…… SHIT！」
Move 3, a thrust toward the opponent's chest, reality match rate 94.842 percent――blade angle plus 4.5 degrees from prediction, data corrected――evaded.
Move 4, right-foot load 2.195 kN, thrust to the dantian after a lower feint――hit.
Move 5――evaded.
Move 6――hit.
Just as traced, I simply keep swinging the blade.
Move 7 evaded, Move 8 hit, Move 9 evaded, Move 10 hit――！！ Evaded, hit, evaded, hit, hit, hit――！！！

name: Victoria
message: 「Ngaaaaaaaahhh！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's the end！！」
Landed a full-power horizontal torso sweep on the staggering Victoria-san, completing the trace――

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky！！」
Shizuku-san leans forward out of the spectator stands.

name: Iori
message: 「This is…… amazing」
That sequence of moves Momiji just showed had reached the realm of a master.
Controlling the opponent's movements in advance and making them act as if following oneself. It's a pinnacle of martial arts akin to an aikido air throw.

name: Iori
message: 「Shizuku-san, how many matches has this been for Momiji-san and Victoria-san？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「This is the first time……」
Then did Momiji pull off that line of reading from the very first move……？
Given her Suzakuin heritage, I figured she was no ordinary person…… though I never expected it to go this far.

name: Victoria
message: 「……Haaah, aah, I'm done for, I'm done for～」
Victoria-san, getting back up as if nothing had happened.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky, are you okay...？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah, my Barrier Jacket's still intact, so I'm totally fine~」
She hopped lightly on her feet to prove it. She wasn't just putting on a brave front—she genuinely didn't seem to have taken much damage.

name: Iori
message: 「Incredible, even after taking that much...」

name: Momiji
message: 「...You're sturdier than I expected.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Well, yeah！ I've always been tough！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Still, what you just did was amazing~！ It felt like I was being controlled or something！」

name: Victoria
message: 「How do you do that？ I wanna try it too~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「There is no way to control people at will.」

name: Victoria
message: 「I see~, too bad. Well, whatever~」

name: Victoria
message: 「If that's all you've got, I don't think I'll lose in the main event anyway.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Are you saying you're confident you can beat me at the Martial Festival？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yep, I'll win with ease~♪」
Victoria-san, flashing a carefree smile. It was clearly a provocation.

name: Momiji
message: 「Unfortunately, you shouldn't count on that prediction.」

name: Momiji
message: 「After all, in this practice match, you haven't even managed to touch my Barrier Jacket.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You should at least land a single blow on me before saying something like that.」

name: Victoria
message: 「OK, then I'll do just that.」
Blades raised, the two of them glaring at each other once more. Just as Momiji and Victoria―san were about to move again―
「Hold that match right theeeere！！！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa！？ What's happening！？」
A loud voice echoed throughout the arena.
Above the entrance on the opposite side. In that conspicuous spot, someone of equally conspicuous appearance stood in an imposing stance.

name: Female Student
message: 「Hey, you there, Suzakuin Momiji！」

name: Female Student
message: 「Sneaking around behind my back to have a match—how could such a thing be allowed！」

name: Female Student
message: 「No, definitely not！！」

name: Female Student
message: 「I'm the one who'll put an end to your life. That's been decided since before the dawn of... creation？ Or something...！」

name: Female Student
message: 「In other words, this is fate！ And destiny！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey YOU！ Who the heck are you, anyway！？」

name: Female Student
message: 「Hahahaha, good thing you asked—I'll tell you！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「My family name is Kazamine, and my given name is Setsugekka！ The wild child of Kazamine—that's me！！」
The one who appeared was Kazamine Setsugekka, one of the students in Takamura Class that I'll be taking charge of

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And the weapon I'm using is <d0021>Momijigari</d>！ Ho~w's that, bitter about it, Momiji?！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The 'Definitely gonna take down Suzakuin' person has arrived, ya know~？」
She shows off the Origami she equipped herself

name: Momiji
message: 「Haa... is that so.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Suzakuin-chan, is that one your friend？」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, she's not. I don't have a friend like that, and even if she begged me, I wouldn't want to be friends with her.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Guh, that's a lonely thing to say...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph, well, I guess it's only natural！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You and I aren't friends—we don't need cozying up.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Because we're arch-enemies, <d0022>rivals</d>！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa, that's cool！ Having rivals is super good！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Right~, Senpai gets it！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Fufufu, well, yeah~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm glad you two found kindred spirits in each other.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ki~nda sounds like you're saying something loaded.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Anyway, Kazamine Setsugekka-san.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm currently in the middle of a practice match with Victoria-san. Since it's a nuisance, could you please leave?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No way！ Why should I have to listen to what you say？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I booked this facility privately to have a match with Victoria-san」

name: Momiji
message: 「Outsiders are not permitted inside」

name: Momiji
message: 「Besides, how did you even get in here？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？ I climbed up the wall」

name: Momiji
message: 「Are you a monkey?！ Don't climb a side wall taller than a five-story building！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Honestly, what if you fell? That's dangerous！」
She really is off the charts in every sense... this Setsugekka-san.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Shut up, shut up, it's 'cause you ignore me！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You don't even reply when I send replies on <d0023>Tretter</d>！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because I have you muted」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't mute me！ Don't be so cold or I'll cry！」

name: Victoria
message: 「So, Kazamine-chan. What are YOU doing here？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, oh, now you're asking—listen to this, Victoria-senpai！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I've been challenging Suzakuin Momiji right here to a duel since way back」

name: Victoria
message: 「A duel？ Are you gonna fight to the death？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That seems to be what she calls a practice match」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even so, Momiji keeps running around saying she's busy and won't face me」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm receiving practice match requests from various other people as well」

name: Victoria
message: 「Everyone's interested in Suzakuin-chan, y'know~ Can't really be helped」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nuh-uh, it can't just not be helped！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「'Cause Suzakuin Momiji hasn't had a practice match with anyone from the day she enrolled until today！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Eh, really？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I have, she just doesn't know about them」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't screw with me, you think you can fool me just 'cause I'm an idiot！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I sneak into the places you book claiming you’re having practice matches every single time, and nobody’s ever there！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You shouldn’t be sneaking in, if you think about it with basic common sense.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Today I figured nobody would be there either, and then you actually are！ And on top of that, you’re having a match with someone other than me！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「This is a terrible betrayal！ Totally guilty！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So that’s that—I’m gonna beat Suzakuin！ That’s my destiny~！」
Momiji sighs at Setsugekka, who points a sharp finger at her.

name: Momiji
message: 「Haa... everyone’s ‘Suzakuin, Suzakuin’ this and that... it’s exhausting.」

name: Momiji
message: 「True, I am the eldest daughter of the Suzakuin Family. I understand both the duties I must shoulder and everyone’s expectations.」

name: Momiji
message: 「However, I am not a sideshow.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you want to know my true strength, I’ll show you as much as you like at the Murakumo Martial Festival.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Aside from that, I have no intention of drawing my blade needlessly.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Then what about challenging me to a match？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Tennouji Victoria-san is in a league of her own. Because she’s this academy’s current Toujinegi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I thought I would cross blades once out of respect, in place of a greeting.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then show me some respect too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I have no respect to spare for some unknown wretch who barges into other people’s matches.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Gwaaah！ That pisses me off！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Fine, if that’s how you wanna play it, I’ve got a plan of my own！」
No sooner had she spoken than Setsugekka drew her Origami.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Suzakuin Momiji！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Your smug face, your cocky attitude, your put-on words—from the very tip of your ahoge to the tips of your toenails！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Every single bit of it, I can’t stand a damn thing！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sorry, but I’m gonna wreck this match！！」
Setsugekka charged at terrifying speed and thrust her blade toward Momiji.

name: Momiji
message: 「Wha—... stop it, we’re in the middle of a match！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like I care, you goddamn idiot！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You're the idiot！ That's so rude to Victoria-san！」

name: Victoria
message: 「It's fine, it's fine~, don't worry about it!」

name: Victoria
message: 「Besides, maybe I'll jump in and join the fun too~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「W-Wait, why are you attacking me too, Victoria-san！？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Going by how things are shaping up right now, Suzakuin-chan's the bad guy here, isn't she？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Evil—instantly—slaaaashed！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Exaaactly！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「No I'm not, are you an idiot?！ Kazamine Setsugekka is the bad guy！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Mmm, well, I think the audience would be happier seeing Suzakuin-chan get taught a lesson~」

name: Victoria
message: 「The audience always roots for justice, after all！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Who's the audience！?」
Almost simultaneously―Momiji spins and wards off the blades of Setsugekka and Victoria―san closing in from front and back.

name: Iori
message: 「Ooh…… nice moves, Momiji-san.」
Jindou is built around one-on-one matches and doesn't account for multiple opponents in the first place.
Even so, Momiji is handling a two-on-one properly. She looks capable of real combat, not just Jindou.

name: Shizuku
message: 「U-Um, shouldn't we stop them……！?」

name: Iori
message: 「It's fine, it's fine. Recklessness like this turns into youth eventually, you know, yeah.」
Back when I attended this academy too, I got into fights with all sorts of guys. Looking back now, they're all good memories.
Well, on top of that, there's also the fact that I want to see Suzakuin Momiji and Kazamine Setsugekka—how those two fight—with my own two eyes.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yoooou, shatter to pieces！！！」
Catching Momiji off guard while she was distracted by Victoria-san, Setsugekka slipped inside her guard. Right after landing a punch, she unleashed a ferocious kick.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ghk……！ You know hand-to-hand martial arts……！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Damn right, that was Mishima-ryuu Type Hinoto: Enga！」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, Setsugekka-san's a practitioner of Mishima-ryuu！」
<d0024>Mishima-ryuu Martial Arts</d> is an ancient school and a practical martial art specialized in taking on sword-wielding fighters.
There's someone from the Mishima Family in the Tenju Special Forces Group too. He's a good-natured middle-aged guy who dotes on his niece and always shows off pictures of her.

name: Momiji
message: 「I see…… In that case, I won’t let you get any closer！」
Setsugekka blocks a flurry of longsword strikes swung at the speed of sound with her arms crossed in an X.
In the blink of an eye, the distance between them had been widened.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey-hey~ Suzakuin-chan, don’t forget about me, okay！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Guh…… How troublesome……！！」
Just when she thought she’d pushed one back, the other comes closing in. Because of that, Momiji was forced onto the defensive.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nnyaroooh, take another hit！！」
Using <d0025>Shukuchi</d>, Setsugekka leaps right above the ground to close the gap.
Mishima-ryuu originally relies on bare hands and fists and doesn’t use things like Origami.
However, she’d added tweaks here and there to make full use of a body strengthened by Origami’s Tenju.

name: Momiji
message: 「I told you I wouldn’t let you get close！」
Even so, Momiji had the upper hand.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nnaaaahhh！？」
Taking the full force of Momiji’s all-out blade strike, Setsugekka gets sent flying dramatically all the way to the wings of the stage.
Just like that, Setsugekka stopped moving.

name: Shizuku
message: 「K-, Kazamine-san, is she going to be okay……」

name: Iori
message: 「Her Barrier Jacket was deployed, so I think she isn’t injured, but……」
Having taken Momiji’s blow straight on, she might have a concussion.

name: Momiji
message: 「Now then, the nuisance is gone. Victoria-san, let’s resume our practice match.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm~, I wonder about that~」
Ahead of Victoria―san’s gaze―Setsugekka staggers to her feet.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Tch…… Damn it all, my guts are boiling over……！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Getting cocky just ‘cause I was playing nice. Should I knock that damn head right off your shoulders……！！」
Setsugekka’s aura completely shifted.
Something pitch-black—neither fighting spirit nor miasma—is pouring out from all over her body.
Her sharply gleaming eyes held a murderous intent that looked ready to shoot you dead.

name: Iori
message: 「What is that…… What’s going on！？」
Her vibe is completely different from the Setsugekka from just a moment ago. Like that, she’s practically—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Suzakuin Momiji…… I’m gonna kill you right here！！！」
The instant Setsugekka kicked off the ground. Before they knew it, Setsugekka’s body was right beside Momiji.

name: Momiji
message: 「Guh！？」
Setsugekka's fist swings down casually, and Momiji hurriedly catches it. Having caught it, Momiji loses her balance.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Type Kanoe: Gouhou！！！」
Right then, the instant Setsugekka stomps the ground――Setsugekka's fist, thrust straight upward, crosses paths with Momiji's Origami.

name: Momiji
message: 「Guaaah！？」
Unable to kill the momentum, Momiji is sent flying all the way to the edge of the stage.

name: Victoria
message: 「Amazin'！ You suddenly got strong, Super Saiya-jin！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Shut up, you barbarian！」
Setsugekka's arm strikes Victoria like a lariat, knocking her flying toward the edge too.

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, whoa……！」
Speed and power beyond any comparison to Setsugekka just moments ago. Including her aura, she's practically a different person.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Th-That's Kazamine-san going berserk…… We have to call Sasaki-sensei……！」

name: Iori
message: 「Shizuku-san, you know what that is！？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Um, Kazamine Setsugekka-san is famous for having a slightly special constitution.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「From what I've heard, when her emotions flare up, her telepathy/mental-resonance reading shoots up astronomically and becomes immeasurable.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Her physical ability, speed, and durability are all boosted by orders of magnitude. Because of that, rumors spread even among the third-years.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, so she's the type whose potential fluctuates with emotion, just like Victoria-san.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「If only she just got stronger………」

name: Shizuku
message: 「When Kazamine-san starts going berserk, her personality suddenly changes and turns violent, and she stops listening to anyone.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I heard that around mid-April, Kazamine-san went berserk during class, and the homeroom teacher who tried to stop her got injured.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「So the homeroom teacher threw in the towel, and Kazamine-san was transferred to another class.」

name: Iori
message: 「N-No way, another class……」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Among the first-years who enrolled this year, a class that gathered only problem children that ordinary teachers can't handle……」

name: Shizuku
message: 「The name is, if I remember right, Takamura Class.」
……I see, so that's how it is.
Murakumo Academy is the highest-level educational institution for Jindou.
In an academy like that, lacking teachers to teach is strange if you think about it normally.
I'd wondered about it, and I finally understand the trick behind it.
What do you mean 『It's fine because it's all fun, cute girls』！

name: Iori
message: 「Huff, huff, huff... I'll have a good, unhurried talk with Sasaki-sensei later...！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Um, this isn't the time to be saying leisurely things like having a good talk... If we don't stop Kazamine-san, something terrible is going to happen...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's fine. Leave it to me.」
I take off my jacket and undo the cuff buttons of my dress shirt.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Huh, b-but...！」

name: Iori
message: 「About Takamura Class that I mentioned earlier,」

name: Iori
message: 「as of today, I became their sub-homeroom teacher.」
I leap down from the stands onto the stage and approach Setsugekka.

name: Iori
message: 「You're Kazamine Setsugekka-san, right?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...What is it, you bastard?」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm Muragaki Iori, who became your sub-homeroom teacher today. Nice to meet you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph... Like I care. I have no business with you, stand back. I'm going to strike down Suzakuin now.」

name: Iori
message: 「I can't let you do that. She's my student, too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You bastard... Are you planning to get in my way？」

name: Iori
message: 「Less get in your way and more that I want to talk.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Shut up! I have nothing to talk about with the likes of you!!」
Just as I think she shifts her weight, she charges in like a bullet.

name: Iori
message: 「...Your back's wide open！」
Carried by her own momentum, Setsugekka lunges forward and stumbles clumsily. It's because I got behind her and pushed her back.

name: Iori
message: 「That's dangerous, attacking out of nowhere like that. I don't even have an Origami on me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You little...！」
The fist Setsugekka throws only slices through the air where I used to be. It doesn't even graze me.

name: Iori
message: 「Look closer—your footing's sloppy！」
Sweeping the leg she stepped forward with toward me, Setsugekka loses her balance and rolls across the ground.

name: Iori
message: 「Your movements are sloppy. At this rate, you were stronger before you went berserk.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Damn you, looking down on me like that…… I won't forgive you！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Go easy on you and you let it go to your head, you lowlife！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'll make you taste the fate of someone who mocked me！！！」
With a roaring sound, a ferocious fighting spirit condenses onto Setsugekka's fist.

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, whoa, that's bad news……！」
If she unleashes that all at once, it's going to be a disaster.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hahaha, the fool who had the audacity to call himself my teacher before took this and stayed bedridden for a whole week！！」
It really is a miracle he got away with just being bedridden.
If a human without a Barrier Jacket took a hit like that, they'd get blown away without even leaving bones behind.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Here I come, lowlife…… Return to nothingness beneath my fist！」
Setsugekka closing in with Shukuchi
No matter what, taking that would be bad news. I scramble backward recklessly.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Take this――Mishima-ryuu Type Mizunoto: Banzetsu！！！」
Her gleaming fist shot out at godlike speed.
The form is a pure straight punch, yet with an earth-shaking stomp and Tenju focused on a single point, that blow became a power strike beyond words――

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa, that's amazing……」
In my place, having dodged Setsugekka's devastating blow at the last split second

name: Shizuku
message: 「Aah…… t-th-the stadium wall」

name: Momiji
message: 「We're supposed to use this for the summer Martial Festival…… What are we going to do about this」
The stadium's reinforced outer wall shattered into pieces……. A huge, gaping hole was blown right through it.
